Both memoranda describe a private bill seeking an additional payment arising from a serviceman's death, recount an official line-of-duty determination, note payment of the regular death gratuity, discuss National Service Life Insurance and the survivor's ineligibility for Veterans' Administration benefits, and conclude that the existing uniform benefit system forecloses further special relief. This unusually specific combination, along with parallel wording and factual sequence, is materially stronger than generic private-bill boilerplate.
